sources.prompt: Create one production seamless square game floor texture for Soulmonsters Gruta dos Elos. Directly overhead orthographic material, fills entire square, no perspective, no borders. FLAT 2D inked graphic cut-paper geological slate. Broad irregular interlocking natural slate plates around muted blue grey #3D515B, shadow planes #30424A, occasional restrained planes #4C6269. Approximately 20 irregular geological shapes across the whole square, thin broken navy fissures NOT thick grouting, sparse little chips, tiny moss-grey flecks only in a few crevices. Shapes like folded paper geological fragments, NOT literal paper, no regular diamonds or paving bricks. Mostly quiet connected stone, purposeful asymmetric variation, medium-low contrast, visible at small game scale. Pure flat fills and clean sparse ink lines, no photorealism, no watercolor grain, no shading gradient, no raised rocks, no decorative icons, no crystals, no bright whites, no glow, no text. Opposite edges should tile seamlessly.

Create one production seamless square walkable cave path material for Soulmonsters Gruta dos Elos. Directly overhead orthographic full square, no perspective, no border. Flat 2D clean graphic artwork. Muted warm grey earthen brown #796D57 and #6B624F. A continuous surface of compacted earth with sparse irregular partially buried broad flat slate fragments, about 10 small low-contrast fractured plates over entire square, NOT a cobbled pavement. A few shallow broken earth cracks and scattered tiny ochre stone chips. Mostly quiet earth patches between stones. 3 flat tones, subtle navy-brown ink edges, clear natural surface and no smooth blank fill. No road edges painted, no path stripe, no borders, no repetitive grid, no bright stones, no deep holes, no raised rocks, no watercolor noise, no gradient, no props, no text. Seamlessly repeatable opposite edges.
